classification_note: Each record states whether values are REAL OBSERVATION, MODEL ASSUMPTION, DERIVED PARAMETER, or SIMULATED VALUE.

sources.dataset: Our World in Data COVID-19 Dataset
sources.publisher: Our World in Data / Global Change Data Lab
sources.update_frequency: Periodically updated public files; not a live hospital feed
sources.geographic_scope: Country-day panel; this project uses iso_code GBR (hospital fields) and OWID_WRL (optional case signal)
sources.frequency: Daily (some hospital fields are weekly or intermittently reported)
sources.access_method: HTTPS CSV; streamed and filtered to selected iso_code
sources.current_vs_historical: Historical time series that is periodically updated. NOT real-time occupancy of any named hospital.
sources.relevant_fields: Hospital admissions and ICU occupancy as national aggregates; new_cases_smoothed as an epidemiological pressure signal only.
sources.notes: National aggregates are not this model's five-resource hospital. Transformations to hourly arrival rates are DERIVED.

sources.dataset_title: Coronavirus (COVID-19) in the UK — national metrics
sources.publisher: UK Health Security Agency / UK Government
sources.update_frequency: Historical dashboard API; reporting has largely ended
sources.geographic_scope: United Kingdom national overview (not a single hospital)
sources.units: daily counts (admissions, hospital cases, MV beds)
sources.current_vs_historical: Historical public-health series. NOT live census of a single hospital.
sources.notes: Preferred arrival/occupancy source when reachable. If unavailable, the pipeline uses cache then a labeled synthetic fixture.

sources.dataset: COVID-19 length of hospital stay: a systematic review and data synthesis
sources.dataset_title: COVID-19 length of hospital stay (summary distributions)
sources.publisher: BMC Medicine (Springer Nature); authors Rees EM et al.
sources.geographic_scope: Pooled studies; this project uses outside-China summaries
sources.coverage: 52 studies (mostly China); summary LoS for hospital and ICU, China vs outside China. Early-pandemic evidence (2020).
sources.frequency: Not a time series; pooled study summaries
sources.access_method: Open-access article (CC-BY 4.0); statistics transcribed into literature_los.json
sources.current_vs_historical: Historical published evidence (2020). Not current local hospital LoS.
sources.notes: This project does not ingest patient-level LoS records. Fitted Gamma/Weibull/Lognormal parameters are DERIVED from published median and IQR.
